title: Small Business Support Grant – Bondi Beach December 2025: accountant's letter template
summary: This page provides instructions and templates for obtaining an accountant's letter required for the Small Business Support Grant in Bondi Beach.
what_you_need: Copy the sample text onto business letterhead that includes the name, address, and ABN or ACN of your business or employer.
Provide all the information requested in the table.
Insert the requested details into the square brackets [ ] and delete any irrelevant choices.
Sign the letter or insert a digital signature, ensuring it includes the signatory's name, title, and contact details.
Attach the completed letter to the application when requested.
